choice.name: image_vae
choice.reason: A conditional encoder-decoder provides a comparatively stable baseline for labeled augmentation under a short budget. Its Gaussian observation model may smooth histology texture, so utility must be measured rather than inferred from ELBO.
choice.hyperparameter_rationale: Use all image pixels, scaled by 255, with complete label_0 one-hot conditioning in encoder and decoder. A 32-dimensional latent and 128-unit projection provide moderate capacity for small RGB patches; batch size 64 limits activation memory while supporting efficient updates. Adam uses betas (0.9,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping at 10. The 0.001 learning rate is an exploratory starting point. Twenty epochs and patience four bound training and allow several validation observations before stopping; 15 minutes is a hard ceiling, not a runtime estimate. Select the lowest complete fixed-seed Monte Carlo validation loss under the fixed standard-deviation 0.1 Gaussian, beta=1 ELBO. Generate 2,500 labeled Gaussian decoder draws from standard-normal latents, clip to [0,1] and use the trainer image output contract; retain decoder means separately without treating them as equivalent samples.

choice.name: image_gan
choice.reason: A conditional GAN offers a complementary implicit image model that may capture sharper texture, while carrying greater instability and mode-collapse risk. Its independent validation selection and downstream comparison justify a second exploratory candidate rather than assuming it outperforms the VAE.
choice.hyperparameter_rationale: Scale uint8 pixels to [-1,1] and condition generator and discriminator on label_0 under trainer contract 1.0. A 64-dimensional latent provides flexible generation noise and hidden width 128 keeps capacity moderate; batch size 64 shares the memory-conscious setting of the VAE. Separate Adam optimizers use learning rate 0.0002 and required betas (0.5,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping at 10. Use the specified single discriminator update followed by non-saturating generator update. Twenty epochs, patience four and a 15-minute ceiling bound exploration without promising convergence. Select checkpoints by the required aggregate/per-class pooled-feature validation Wasserstein score using fixed up-to-512 training/validation subsets, a training-fitted scaler and fixed validation-label-matched latent draws. This score is neither FID nor ELBO. Generate 2,500 samples by rescaling and rounding tanh outputs to uint8, without extra observation noise.

choice.name: image_gan
choice.reason: Retain the conditional GAN as the sole revision candidate because its contracted checkpoint score improved substantially through epoch 13 and its pooled-feature and texture discrepancies were smaller than the VAE's, although both models failed quality screens and neither established augmentation benefit. Test a smaller optimization step against the observed late checkpoint-score fluctuation. This comparison does not establish overall perceptual superiority: the GAN pixel-PCA discrepancy was larger.
choice.hyperparameter_rationale: The sole scientific setting change is learning_rate 0.0002 to 0.0001 for both optimizers. fit_diagnostics validation_feature_wasserstein decreased from 0.292296 at epoch 10 to 0.254423 at epoch 13, then increased to 0.278949 at epoch 14. Together with feature_wasserstein ratio 2.722451, diversity ratio 0.791538 and negative synthetic-versus-resampling validation utility, this justifies a bounded test of smaller updates rather than an identical rerun. Predicted effect: smaller steps may reduce checkpoint-score fluctuations and improve conditional distribution matching. Competing explanation: finite-subset variation, insufficient training or architectural limits may explain the fluctuation and discrepancies; a smaller rate may instead slow learning and leave diversity or utility unchanged or worse. Generator/discriminator loss magnitudes do not prove imbalance or collapse. Preserve latent_dim 64 for noise capacity, hidden_dim 128 for moderate network width, batch_size 64 for the previously exercised memory setting, epochs 20 and patience 4 to isolate the optimization change. Preserve all pixels, selected_features 0 and 2,500 generated samples to maintain the augmentation dose. The max_minutes change from 15 to 30 is a resource ceiling change, concentrating the explicitly supplied remaining allowance on one candidate; it is not an estimated runtime or an epoch extension. Start from scratch. Scale pixels to [-1,1] and use complete label_0 conditioning under trainer contract 1.0. Separate Adam optimizers use required betas (0.5,0.999), float32 and gradient norm clipping 10, with one discriminator update followed by one non-saturating generator update. Select the minimum contracted pooled-feature validation Wasserstein score using fixed up-to-512 training/validation subsets, training-only scaler, fixed latent draws matching validation labels and aggregate/per-class discrepancies. This score is neither ELBO nor FID and does not establish usefulness. Generate standard-normal latent draws through tanh, rescale and round to uint8 without observation noise; final labels cycle across observed classes.

trainer_contract.preprocessing: Select 2..128 genes using training-only dispersion ranking. Deterministic per-cell uniform dequantization, log(count+U), then training-only mean/std. No library normalization. latent_dim equals selected_features.
trainer_contract.training: Exact change-of-variables density of standardized continuous coordinates; Adam betas (0.9,0.999), gradient clip 10. Validation NLL selects best checkpoint and patience. This is not an integer count likelihood or ELBO.
trainer_contract.generation: Normal latent, reverse transforms; planar uses 64-step monotone bisection and checks inverse residual, radial and affine coupling use analytic inverses. Undo training standardization; save continuous log-expression samples without rounding or exponentiation.
trainer_contract.tasks: Unconditional data_generation only. Coupling hidden_dim sets MLP width; planar/radial hidden_dim=16 is an unused schema placeholder.

choice.hyperparameter_rationale: Select 32 genes by training-only dispersion ranking to restrict scope and computation. latent_dim=32 must equal the panel dimension: this standalone density model performs no dimension reduction. Six coupling layers provide moderate depth; hidden_dim=64 sets coupling-network width. Batch size 64 limits working memory while providing multiple updates per epoch. Adam uses learning rate 0.001, betas (0.9,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping at 10 per contract. Train for at most 60 epochs, with patience 8 on validation continuous NLL; select the lowest validation NLL checkpoint. The 15-minute limit is a hard ceiling, not a runtime estimate. Generate 1000 samples for exploratory diagnostics within the 2000-sample limit. No executor pilot cap is assumed. Apply fixed deterministic per-cell Uniform[1e-6,1) jitter, log(count+U), and training-fitted mean/std without library normalization. Fit by continuous maximum likelihood using change of variables, not ELBO or integer count likelihood. Reverse transforms analytically and undo standardization; save continuous log-expression without exponentiation or rounding.

choice.name: realnvp_flow
choice.reason: Its implemented version 1.0 contract matches unconditional continuous log-dequantized generation, with analytic inversion and coupling networks for joint dependencies. Revise the existing candidate rather than divide the remaining exploratory budget among models.
choice.hyperparameter_rationale: Change exactly two scientific settings: learning_rate 0.001 to 0.0002 and coupling-network hidden_dim 64 to 32. fit_diagnostics show train_nll falling from 45.524153 at epoch 1 to 41.723194 at epoch 9, but validation_nll selecting epoch 1 at 45.211610 and ending at 46.535739; its epoch-5-to-9 change was only -0.017088. Together with failed continuous_feature_wasserstein (ratio 3.307854), this motivates testing slower optimization and lower capacity. Predicted effect: less rapid training-specific fitting and potentially better validation-selected marginals. Competing explanations include limited flow expressiveness, dequantization-induced marginal structure or holdout variability; lower capacity could worsen fit, and lower learning rate could merely delay learning. Correlation and diversity screens already passed, so improvement must not come at their expense. Preserve the identical 32-gene training-selected panel and its ordering, six coupling layers, batch size 64, 60-epoch ceiling, patience 8, and 1000 generated samples to limit confounding. latent_dim=32 equals selected_features, with no dimension reduction. Start training from scratch; use Adam betas (0.9,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping 10. Select the lowest validation continuous NLL checkpoint. Apply deterministic per-cell Uniform[1e-6,1) jitter, log(count+U), and training-only mean/std; do not library-normalize. Train by continuous change-of-variables maximum likelihood, not ELBO. Reverse transforms analytically, undo standardization and save continuous log-expression without exponentiation or rounding. The 15-minute ceiling is not a runtime estimate; no executor pilot cap is assumed. Falling NLL alone cannot demonstrate sample quality or utility.
